title: GDScript Tokenizer crash when reporting mixed spaces and tabs for indentation on the first line
body:
### Tested versions

- master v4.5.dev (51b0379e5), 4.5dev3
- not in 4.4.1

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7602) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.82 GiB memory

### Issue description

Add a tab and a space on the first line of a script, and the editor will crash.

### Steps to reproduce

Copy and paste this line to the first line of a GDScript file:
```gdscript
	 var x
```
(It has a tab followed by a space and then other text)
Wait a second for the parsing to trigger, and it should crash.
